feed.title: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?

entry.title: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?
entry.summary:
Edil Medeiros stands out as a strong candidate for the role of BIP editor due to a proven track record within the Bitcoin community. His professional background demonstrates a high level of proficiency in the skills essential for this position, reflecting both dedication and technical capability.
Confidence is expressed in Edil's ability to not only fulfill the responsibilities required but also to further advance the progress already achieved in the role. His experience and commitment suggest that he will continue to contribute meaningfully to the ongoing development and improvement of relevant projects.
